subject: MedSentry: SCIM delta export + JITA admin traceback (SIG intake)

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: SIG intake — SCIM delta + JITA admin access traceback

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake we need a compact artifact bundle that demonstrates provisioning and elevated access handling for the last 30 days. Specifically we need: 

- A SCIM delta export covering 2028-02-16 through 2028-03-17 (format: csv or JSON lines; include operation type and timestamp)
- A JITA (just-in-time) admin exception log showing elevated admin sessions and the request/approval chain
- Samples of SAML assertions for two recent SSO logins (redacted PII is fine, but include timestamps and assertion attributes)
- A Role → Permission mapping that shows how least-privilege is enforced (worksheet format preferred)

We are on a tight timeline for our external SIG review — would you be able to deliver the bundle by end-of-day 2028-03-22? If that's not possible please propose a split delivery (SCIM + SAML first, JITA bundle next).

I've attached our intake PDF (Medsentry_SIG_intake_v2.pdf) with the checklist. Please confirm if you need any specific export formats.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Senior Compliance Analyst
MedSentry Health
compliance@medsentry.com

Julia — thanks for the clear checklist. We can support the requested artifacts. Quick clarifying questions before we start producing exports: 

1) SCIM delta: do you want a single consolidated delta file or one per day? We can provide either; single CSV with an operation column is easiest for auditors.
2) JITA: are you looking for session recordings or audit log entries? We can provide structured audit entries (requestor, approver, justification, start/end timestamps) + the policy IDs that triggered elevation.
3) SAML samples: to be safe we'll redact the NameID and any PII but include the attribute map. Does that meet your needs?

Plan: Laura will pull the SCIM and role-mapping artifacts, Marissa will curate the JITA audit records and SAML samples. I will package and upload to a shared Drive folder and send a checksum. Target initial drop: 2028-03-21 (SCIM + SAML + role mapping). Final JITA archive by 2028-03-22 if that works.

Sean Gallagher

Julia / team — circling back with the proposed artifact set and where we'll place each file.

Artifact plan (initial drop 2028-03-21):
- scim_delta_20280301-0317.csv — consolidated delta export from our provisioning service; columns: timestamp, operation (create/update/delete), externalId, userPrincipalName, targetGroup, source (SCIM connector).
- role_mapping_minpriv.xlsx — workbook with role -> permission sheets and a brief column showing "minimum-required" justification for each role.
- saml_assertions_samples.txt — two assertion samples (NameID redacted, attributes preserved).

JITA audit (final drop 2028-03-22):
- jita_audit_202803_records.zip — CSV of elevation requests, approver chain, policy_id, justification, approved_by, duration_seconds. Includes a README with redaction rules.

Delivery: I'll upload the initial drop to the Drive folder and paste a sha256 checksum in this thread. For the JITA archive we will include both the CSV and an exported event trace from the runtime (for timeline reconstruction).

One ask from our side: please confirm the redaction level you need for user identifiers — full email vs. hashed email. For SIG we typically provide hashed user IDs + clear service account names. If MedSentry requires full emails we will need a Data Processing Addendum signed (let me know).

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMedsentryEvidenceLink

Thanks Laura — that plan works. A couple quick points: 

- Redaction: hashed user IDs + full service account names is acceptable for our external report. We will request clear emails only if follow-up is needed.
- Delivery cadence: initial drop on 2028-03-21 and JITA archive on 2028-03-22 is fine.
- Please include a short readme in the JITA zip that lists the fields and any normalization applied to timestamps (UTC vs local).

One additional ask: can you include in the package a short note describing how long ephemeral admin sessions remain active and the rotation policy for temporary elevation secrets? That helps our traceability doc.

If possible, please password-protect the JITA zip and share the password via a separate email or our secure portal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Julia Park
